# Purpose

The project manager is the interactive interface layer for `projflow`. It should be treated as a view and editing surface over the lower layers, not as a separate execution engine.

# Recommended workflow

```{r}
library(projflow)

plan <- plan_project(
  path = "managed-project",
  components = c("data_preparation", "statistical_analysis", "report", "project_management"),
  infrastructure = c("git", "targets")
)
new_project(plan = plan, open = FALSE)
```

# Dashboard

```{r}
open_dashboard("managed-project")
```

# Governance records

```{r}
add_project_task("Check input data definitions", root = "managed-project")
add_project_risk("Model diagnostics may reveal influential observations", root = "managed-project")
add_project_decision("Keep raw data outside the repository", root = "managed-project")
add_project_milestone("Analysis review complete", root = "managed-project")
```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
check_project("managed-project")
validate_project_dag("managed-project")
project_status_report(root = "managed-project")
```
